{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in key columns
print("\nUnique channels:", sales_df['channel'].unique())
print("Unique customer segments:", sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Unique statuses:", sales_df['status'].unique())

# Inspect revenue column
print("\nRevenue data types:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Revenue sample (first 10):")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(10))

# Convert revenue to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for invalid revenue values
print("\nInvalid revenue values (NaN or negative):", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum() + (sales_df['revenue'] < 0).sum())"}
